patient.employment_status: Freelance video editor with irregular hours
patient.social_context: Has one close friend who does not use cannabis; otherwise limited social contact
patient.background: Fictional freelance video editor who lives alone and works irregular hours.
patient.history_summary: Daily cannabis use since 2014, rising to several times a day in 2018; two short attempts to stop in 2020 and 2022.
patient.treatment_summary: One counseling intake in 2024 without follow-up; counseling sessions every second week since December 2025.

history_events.description: Use rises to several times a day after moving to a new city.
Stops for nine days, then resumes.
Second attempt to stop lasts about two weeks.

factors.description: Irregular deadlines that break up his routine.
A large share of his income goes toward cannabis.
A close friend who does not use and checks in weekly.
Has less contact with some friends than a few years ago.

interventions.reported_outcome: Attended the intake appointment and did not return.

progress.note: Uses several times a day; says he is thinking about stopping.
Has booked a second counseling appointment.
Reports using on fewer days and sleeping better on some nights.
